actuator.stroke_margin_note: The old 125 script defined no margin and only asserted POS >= 0. Set to 1.0 to match p300. This TIGHTENS the check; it cannot loosen it.

calibration.note: The 10% test point shifts by ~1.8% of its target volume versus the old table, which matters for that ISO point.

tips.note: The old 125 script performs NO tip pickup and NO prewet. Whether that is intentional (bare nosecone / permanently fitted tip) or an omission is UNRESOLVED and it changes every Z below.

reservoir_water.note: DERIVED, not stated. The old script uses relative moves: travel((0,0,5)) at start -> Z=5, then travel((0,0,45)) -> Z=50.

z_conflict.description: UNRESOLVED. p125 water Z=50 is 10 mm LOWER than p300's 40, but p125 tube Z=20 is 25 mm HIGHER than p300's 45. A constant tip-length offset would shift BOTH by the same amount and in the same direction. These two cannot both be right for the same reservoir and the same rack.
z_conflict.likely_cause: The 15 mm tube descent was inherited from examples/PipetteCurve.py rather than measured.
z_conflict.action: Measure both against the same reference before running p125 through the new pipeline.

z_reference.note: UNMEASURED for this effector. deck z.stage_surface 114.75 was taken with the p300 bare nosecone; a different pipette body sits at a different height, so p125's own stage-contact Z is unknown and its absolute Z limits are unverified. Its working Z values (water 50, tube 20) pass against the p300 reference, but that is not the same as being checked.
